mapper.select: SELECT tp.trip_plan_id, tp.user_id, tp.anchor_content_id, tp.title, tp.trip_date, tp.visit_start_time, tp.visit_end_time, tp.save_yn, tp.ai_yn, tp.transport_md, tp.headcount, tp.created_at, tp.upd_at, e.event_name AS anchor_event_name FROM trip_plan tp JOIN event e ON e.event_content_id = tp.anchor_content_id WHERE tp.trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId}

SELECT tp.trip_plan_id, tp.user_id, tp.anchor_content_id, tp.title, tp.trip_date, tp.visit_start_time, tp.visit_end_time, tp.save_yn, tp.ai_yn, tp.transport_md, tp.headcount, tp.created_at, tp.upd_at FROM trip_plan tp WHERE tp.trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ti.trip_item_id, ti.seq_order, ti.item_type, ti.event_content_id, ti.place_content_id, ti.start_time, ti.duration_min, ti.ai_reason, ti.time_fix_yn, COALESCE(e.event_name, p.place_name) AS name, COALESCE(e.addr, p.addr) AS addr, COALESCE(e.mapx, p.mapx) AS mapx, COALESCE(e.mapy, p.mapy) AS mapy, COALESCE(e.image_url, p.image_url) AS image_url, p.open_time, p.close_time, p.break_open_time, p.break_close_time FROM trip_item ti LEFT JOIN event e ON ti.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.event_content_id = ti.event_content_id LEFT JOIN place p ON ti.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.content_id = ti.place_content_id WHERE ti.trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} ORDER BY ti.seq_order
SELECT content_id, place_name AS name, display_yn FROM place WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND content_type_cd = 39
SELECT event_content_id AS content_id, event_name AS name, display_yn, event_start_date, event_end_date, event_start_time FROM event WHERE event_content_id = #{eventContentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_item SET seq_order = #{seqOrder}, item_type = #{itemType}, event_content_id = #{eventContentId}, place_content_id = #{placeContentId}, start_time = #{startTime}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, ai_reason = #{aiReason}, time_fix_yn = #{timeFixYn} WHERE trip_item_id = #{tripItemId} AND trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_item (trip_plan_id, seq_order, item_type, event_content_id, place_content_id, start_time, duration_min, ai_reason, time_fix_yn) VALUES (#{tripPlanId}, #{seqOrder}, #{itemType}, #{eventContentId}, #{placeContentId}, #{startTime}, #{durationMin}, #{aiReason}, #{timeFixYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_plan SET save_yn = TRUE WHERE trip_plan_id = #{tripPlanId} AND save_yn = FALSE
